title: Animosity
description:
How many raccoons does it take to fire a cannon? What is the maximum transport range of a trash can? Answer these important questions in Animosity: a procedurally-generated platformer that takes you from the fires of revolution to the edge of space. You play as Red, a special raccoon who must liberate the species from the angry ape menace. Join together to fight tooth and nail, bolt and bullet against those who want you dead. 

Game currently features:• Fully procedural levels, every fight is new.

• Physics based play and weaponry.

• Companion AI, no friends necessary!

• Split Screen Local play up to 4 players, some friends necessary.

• Cooperative, Deathmatch, Speedrun game modes.

Plays best with a dual stick controller.
description_short: Through claws and bullets, Red must save his friends from the angry ape menace. Procedural levels create a new experience with every play. Companion AI gives you the backup you need. Coop, Deathmatch, and Speedrun for up to 4 player split screen. Xbox controllers recommended.
